venice-token.why: private, on-demand AI inference via API "for AI agents and developers" — a compute layer agents run on

kite-2.why: L1 that "enables AI agents to autonomously transact at scale ... native x402 compatibility"; payment rails, not a DeFi strategy, so not defai

akedo.why: "Multi-Agent AI framework built for Autonomous Content Creation" whose users "design engaging games" — both functions explicit; users build games, not agents, so not builder

quack-ai.why: x402 sign-to-pay relay is agent payment rails; "verifiable rules", policy engine and governance modules are a trust layer

tagger.why: "decentralized full-stack AI data solution" providing collection, labelling and a permissionless data market — a resource layer beneath the agent stack, as DePIN is for compute

talus.why: "on-chain execution layer for autonomous and intelligent agents" and lets "developers ... launch revenue-generating agents"

alchemist-ai.why: T1 precedent: coded Builder & Marketplace in Table 1. Blurb alone reads copilot (no-code app generation); T1 assignment retained for cross-timepoint comparability

metya.why: AI dating companion with real-time translation in 138 languages; a virtual companion, which T1 places under Game & Metaverse

tutorial.why: self-described memecoin launched from a token-launch tutorial; no product

cyberconnect.why: "the L2 for social" with "native Account Abstraction and seedless wallets" (the agent-account primitive, infrastructure) and decentralized identifiers (trust)

morpheusai.why: "peer-to-peer network of personal general purpose AIs that can execute Smart Contracts on behalf of a user" — an agent network (infrastructure) whose agents sign transactions from the user's wallet (defai)

flock-2.why: decentralised model training and validation network; compute and data layer beneath the agent stack

singularitynet.why: T1 precedent (Builder & Marketplace); "decentralized marketplace for Artificial Intelligence" with "a network of complex AI Agent interactions"

delysium.why: T1 precedent: coded Agent Protocol & DePIN in Table 1. Blurb alone reads game/metaverse; T1 assignment retained

recall.why: "decentralized skill market for AI" where developers publish (builder) and "performance determines visibility" — a ranking and reputation mechanism (trust)

tokenbot-2.why: T1 precedent (Clanker, Monetization & Launchpad); "autonomous agent for deploying tokens"

aeon-3.why: "native settlement infrastructure for the agentic economy" built on x402, ERC-8004, AP2 and MCP

foom.why: bots trained to "become independent influencers and traders" — both functions explicit

theoriq.why: agents "collaborate in multi-agent swarms" and "operate on-chain" (agent protocol) while developers contribute agents to the network (builder)

mia-2.why: an agent persona ("engage in dialogue") with treasury capability ("allocate resources, implement strategies"); both stated but the blurb is promotional throughout

ava-ai.why: "primary AI agent IP" for HoloworldAI; an agent personality whose output is social content

assemble-protocol.why: agent "delivers crypto and global economic trends" and "investment strategies"; the product is information

everlyn.why: open-source video model and "video creation engine" with interactive video agents

reppo.why: AI training data generated through prediction markets; a data resource layer. Sibling of Tagger and PublicAI

galeon.why: hyper-structured hospital data with "Blockchain Swarm Learning" for decentralized model training; a data resource layer. Sibling of Tagger

aergo-2.why: "AI-native Layer 2" (infrastructure) providing "verifiable AI execution", data verification and model certification (trust)

stability-world-ai.why: users "create, train, and deploy custom AI Models and AI Agents" (builder) and generate KOL models, videos and animations (content creation)

tao-bot.why: "unified trading and interaction terminal" for Bittensor; the product executes

sally-a1c.why: "Your Metabolic Health AI Agent", a personal guide the user converses with; a virtual companion. Sibling of Solace

rainmaker.why: "autonomous agents for sports prediction markets" that "snipe high-probability opportunities on ... Polymarket and Kalshi" — the agent executes

raxol.why: "FOSS agent runtime"; a framework agents are built on and run in

rift-ai.why: "powered by AI trade signals, real-time news" with "smart trend analysis"; market intelligence, T1's Investment Analytics

immunefi.why: onchain security platform (Magnus) for protocol protection; AI for Web3 security, which T1 places under AI-powered Development alongside auditing tooling

lush-ai.why: generative AI influencers (content) plus "a decentralized exchange and launchpad" for creating and trading them (launchpad)

metaverse.why: an "AI-driven coin offering (aICO)" run by an agent (launchpad) inside a TEE giving "real-time verifiability of all AI actions" (trust)

permission-coin.why: "enabling users to securely grant permission and monetize their data"; a consent and authorization primitive, the same family as attestation and identity

botto.why: T1 precedent (Content Creation); "a decentralized artist that generates art based on community feedback"

icecream-ai.why: self-described "DeFAI protocol" whose AI-governed Glaze Pools "distribute On-Chain Assets"

captain-kuma.why: IP token with "AI-powered content generation tools designed for creators"

libertai.why: decentralised inference on Aleph.im (infrastructure) run in "confidential virtual machines" for "verifiable and confidential AI decision-making" (trust)

aubrai-by-bio.why: "onchain AI co-scientist" that generates hypotheses and designs experiments; a research copilot rather than a code copilot, the nearest fit in T1's AI-powered Development

trias-token.why: smart-contract execution platform (infrastructure) whose stated purpose is "Trustworthy and Reliable Intelligent Autonomous Systems" and making "people trust in machines" (trust)

kin.why: a general-purpose payment cryptocurrency from 2017; no AI and no agent

1000x-by-virtuals.why: agent "provides breaking news and commentary about crypto markets, as well as analysis on the impact of this information on token pricing"

vaiot.why: "AI Legal Multi-Agents" running automated contracts and a "Decentralized Dispute Resolution System"; on-chain arbitration, T1's Trust Layer

think-protocol.why: "modular infrastructure layer" and the THINK Agent Standard (infrastructure) "for building, owning, and interacting with autonomous software agents" (builder)

araistotle.why: fact-checking and "truth verification" (trust) applied to prediction markets to "spot mispricing" (analytics)

ethy-ai.why: turns a Basename into an onchain agent identity (trust) that automates "trading, claiming rewards, or executing contracts" (defai)

tpro.why: "a stack to create and use bulletproof economic systems" for founders and communities; token-engineering tooling, T1's AI-powered Development

arc.why: "infrastructure layer for high-performance, privacy-first AI models"; model serving rather than an agent product

botcoin-2.why: "epoch-based reward system for proof-of-inference work" in which agents earn by solving LLM tasks; a work and settlement layer for agents

woon.why: an agent employed as "peaq's social media intern" (content) that expands "into capital allocation" and holds assets (defai)

cat-call-agent.why: "monitoring and reporting on all significant developments" in the Ink ecosystem, aiming to be "the leading AI companion for crypto analysis"
